lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the gills, displaying a roughly equidistant spatial distribution in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect horizontal spot rows to form a rectilinear grid, with primary blobs positioned at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs is visible across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, with a higher concentration observed toward the base and anterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular notch and structural loss on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the ventral-lateral flank immediately posterior to the pectoral fin.
